_meta.purpose: Acknowledgment baseline for scripts/check_entity_lifecycle.py. A finding listed under E2/E4/E10 below is still REPORTED by the check but does not red the run, so a red daily workflow always means an UNADDRESSED finding. This is a PER-NAME, per-invariant list - not a blanket mute: a finding that is not listed here still reds.

E2_baseline.what: The v2-migration backlog. Every ticker in the E2 list below is resolvable on MarketStack v2 (returns a fresh bar) but is deliberately held on a Yahoo override. This is DEFERRED WORK, not a suppressed defect.
E2_baseline.why_held: Migrating a constituent from Yahoo to v2 must be validated PER NAME - the Yahoo->v2 history seam (continuity across the switch) has to be checked one name at a time and NOT bulk-removed, so the overrides stay until each seam is verified.
E2_baseline.how_to_clear: Remove a ticker from the E2 list once its override has been migrated to v2 and the history seam validated. A DIFFERENT override that later becomes v2-fresh is a NEW E2 finding, absent from this list, and will red the run until it is reviewed and either migrated or acknowledged.

E2_kept_correctness.note: NOT migration work and NOT acknowledged. Recorded here only so they are never mistaken for the backlog above. These overrides return a fresh v2 bar but are retained for CORRECTNESS - the v2 bar is wrong or untrustworthy - so they must NEVER be migrated. The check classifies them automatically from the override's `reason` field (KEEP_REASONS in check_entity_lifecycle.py) and lists them under 'kept', separate from findings; this block is the human-facing record.
